newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom to set commercial ATM services.
newsitem.headline: Telecom to set commercial ATM services.

text.p: Telecom New Zealand Limited said on Monday that it planned to launch commercial Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) high-speed networking services later this year supported by Siemens and Newbridge Networks switching equipment acquired on five-year contracts.
"Using ATM, businesses can run more advanced applications like large client server databases and manage large file transfers between sites," Telecom said in a statement.
Initially it plans to instal network switches in Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch and they will be connected using a synchronous digital hierarchy (SDH)-based network.
